name: codetogo
description: CodeToGo companion commands and skills for Claude Code — answer how-to questions from the docs at codetogo.app, find and read sessions on this machine via the `codetogo` CLI, spawn titled sessions now (one per task), schedule a pre-seeded session to fire later, copy rich text to the clipboard of the device viewing the session, and hand off / resume / compact (in-place context reset) work across CodeToGo sessions.
